_readme: Every number is { value, unit, source }. A source that starts with 假设 or [估] is ours, not a measurement; anything else names where it was read.

Owners after T0: the furniture entries (and their ignition numbers) belong to task B; gas entries to D; water entries to E; doors and windows to whoever takes door burn-through. Change only your own entries, and keep a source on every number.

Sources: NIST TN 2303 = Hamins et al. 2025, doi 10.6028/NIST.TN.2303. NBSIR 83-2787 = Lawson, Walton, Twilley 1984. NUREG-1805 = 2004, ch. 6 tables 6-2 to 6-5. NIJ 230164 = Wolfe, Mealy, Gottuk 2009. Babrauskas 1981 = NBSIR 81-2271.

The two measured curves (sofa, queen bed) were tabulated from NIST's calorimetry database (FCD) test040 and test038 CSVs by another session, in 室内建筑/家具着火数据.md; T0 copied them from there and did not re-read the CSVs.

sofa.label: 软垫沙发
sofa.reference: NIST TN 2303 test 40: 180 cm three-seat sofa, polyurethane foam, 49.7 kg (sofa A)

peakHRR.source: NIST TN 2303 test 40 (sofa A, three tests: 1.8–2.2 MW)

timeToPeak.source: NIST TN 2303 test 40: 6.57 min from a 128 W flame on the seat

curve.source: NIST FCD test040 CSV, as tabulated in 家具着火数据.md. Time 0 is a small flame lit on the item; ignited by radiation, the smouldering start may be shorter (no data).

radiantFraction.source: NIST TN 2303: sofas 0.32–0.50; 0.4 is the middle (假设 which value)

ignitionTemp.source: 家具着火数据.md: fabric over polyurethane foam, fitted to Villa & Babrauskas 1991 (NISTIR 4652) ignition times

krc.source: [估] back-calculated from T_ig 390 °C, range 0.04–0.22 (家具着火数据.md); bare foam 0.32 (NUREG-1805)

criticalFlux.source: NUREG-1805 / 家具着火数据.md: 16; easily ignited fabrics down to 10 (Babrauskas 1981)

bed_queen.label: 床（Queen，铺床品）
bed_queen.reference: NIST TN 2303 test 38: 30 cm foam mattress with bedding and pillows, 29.4 kg (mattress C with bedclothes)

curve.source: NIST FCD test038 CSV, as tabulated in 家具着火数据.md. Time 0 is a 128 W flame on the pillow.

radiantFraction.source: NIST TN 2303: mattresses 0.34–0.50 (假设 which value)

heatOfCombustion.source: NIST TN 2303: mattresses 11–25 MJ/kg (假设 which value)

coYield.source: NIST TN 2303: mattresses 0.018–0.076 (假设 which value)

bed_king.label: 床（King，铺床品）
bed_king.reference: no test; the queen bed scaled by mattress area

scaleFrom.source: [估] King 1981×2032 mm over Queen 1525×2007 mm; peak and total heat scaled, times kept

cabinet_run.label: 木柜（地柜、吊柜、洗手台柜）
cabinet_run.reference: NIJ 230164 CAL2: four oak-framed plywood wall cabinets in a 1.84 m row, holding paper and cups

peakHRRPerMetre.source: [估] 家具着火数据.md: NIJ 230164 fig. 5-3/5-4, 600–670 kW for 1.84 m [读图], divided by length

totalHeatPerMetre.source: [估] 家具着火数据.md, from NIJ 230164 (fig. 5-3/5-4, table 5-1), divided by length

timeToPeak.source: 假设: the test shows several peaks between 10 and 45 min after ignition

radiantFraction.source: 假设: no wood value measured here; the engine's old default

sootYield.source: 假设: no measurement for wood here

heatOfCombustion.source: 假设: typical for wood products

cabinet_run.note: Wood does not keep burning from a small flame: NBSIR 83-2787's plywood bookcase reached 28 kW under a 50 kW burner and went out 60 s after it stopped. Babrauskas 1981: veneered plywood cabinets did not ignite at 20 kW/m², took 110–236 s at 40 kW/m².

wardrobe.label: 高柜（衣柜）
wardrobe.reference: NBSIR 83-2787 test 61: particleboard wardrobe 1.23×0.40×1.83 m, 120 kg, with clothing (1983 furniture)

peakHRR.source: NBSIR 83-2787 test 61, fig. 121 [读图]: peaks about 1.9 MW and 1.2 MW

heatOfCombustion.source: 假设: typical for wood products

wardrobe.note: The Duplex tall cabinets (0.8×2.0×0.55 m) are close in size, but whether they hold clothing is unknown; the test's MW came largely from the clothing.

totalHeat.source: [估] UL lists 36.9 lb (16.7 kg) for a coffee table; times a wood heat of combustion; range 200–250 MJ

peakHRR.source: no data; task B chooses and marks it 假设

ignitionTemp.source: NUREG-1805 / 家具着火数据.md: oak, piloted

countertop.label: 台面
countertop.reference: material not given in the IFC

combustible.source: 假设: treated as non-combustible (stone or laminate on board is unknown)

door_wood.label: 木门
door_wood.reference: not looked up yet (架构.md 待查: door burn-through time)

window.label: 窗
window.reference: not looked up yet (架构.md 待查: glass breakage temperature)

gas_pipe.label: 燃气管
gas_pipe.reference: IFC: 'Pipe Types:Mechanical Pipe', systems Unit A / Unit B Natural Gas; the model has no gas meter or regulator

combustible.source: steel pipe (假设: the IFC gives no material)

innerDiameter.source: [估] the IFC pipe boxes are 33 mm across, the outer diameter of 1 in steel pipe (33.4 mm); 1 in Schedule 40 is 26.6 mm inside (ASME B36.10, from memory, not re-read)

frictionFactor.source: 假设: Darcy factor for 1 in steel at Re about 1e4 (Moody chart, roughness 0.045 mm)

fittingLoss.source: 假设: K per elbow; handbooks give 0.3–2 (as water_supply)

radiantFraction.source: 假设: share of a gas fire's heat (burning at a cut or failed pipe) lost as radiation; methane flames are among the least sooty, nothing looked up. radiation.js reads it from here, gas.js too

dischargeCoefficient.source: DNV GL Report 630650 Rev. 3 (Hy4Heat WP7, 2020): a 7.2 mm hole at 20 mbar let out 6.4 m³/h of methane, which gives Cd about 0.57 (read by a research sub-session; the Cd is our arithmetic)

gas_supply.label: 燃气网（无限供应）
gas_supply.reference: Each unit's gas line comes in through the west wall about 0.67 m under the ground floor (e573 Unit A, e566 Unit B), outside the simulated grid. The model has no meter, regulator or shut-off valve; one of each is put at that outer end (假设 where they stand). Behind it the network is always there at the regulator's set pressure (架构.md ④); the only thing that stops it is shutting the valve.

deliveryPressure.source: NTSB PAR-19/01 (Silver Spring, 2019) p. 16: 5–7 in. w.c. downstream of the service regulator; 7 in. w.c. taken, and held at any flow (假设: the regulator does not droop)

meterResistance.source: [估] AC-250 diaphragm meter (the common US home meter) is rated 250 SCFH at 0.5 in. w.c. differential, and 528 SCFH at 2 in. (Honeywell/Elster datasheet as summarised by a research sub-session; not read); Δp/Q² from the first gives 3.22e7, from the second 2.89e7

relativeDensity.source: the specific gravity US meters and regulators are rated at (Honeywell datasheet, summary); pure methane is 0.55

heatOfCombustion.source: [估] lower heating value of methane at 20 °C: NIST Chemistry WebBook ΔcH° = −890.7 kJ/mol (higher value), less 2 × 44.0 kJ/mol for the water as vapour, over 24.06 L/mol; US pipeline gas averages 1,036 Btu/ft³ higher value (EIA 2023), about 3 % above methane (not used)

excessFlowValve.source: not modelled: 49 CFR 192.383 has required one on new or replaced single-family services since 2010, closing at its rated flow to 50 % above; a full cut at the flows here (about 15 m³/h) could trip one sized for a home. Whether the Duplex has one is not known

gas_mixture.label: 燃气与空气
gas_mixture.reference: Gas in the air as a volume fraction, carried by the solver (addScalar 'gas'). Lighter than air: it rises at g (1 − relative density) × fraction.

lowerLimit.source: Zabetakis 1965, USBM Bulletin 627, Table A-1: methane 5.0 % (natural gas of 85–95 % methane 4.9 %; the Silver Spring gas 4.78 %, NTSB). Read by a research sub-session

autoignitionTemp.source: Zabetakis 1965, Table A-1: methane 540 °C (natural gas 530 °C). Used as: gas in air this hot lights

flameFuel.source: 假设: a cell holding unburnt fuel worth 20 K or more (fire.fuel) has flame in it and lights gas; the 30 kW igniter keeps about 100 K in its cells

closedPressure.source: Tomlin et al. 2015, J. Loss Prev. 35:169: a stoichiometric natural gas cloud filling a closed room would reach 7–8 bar (read by a research sub-session). 7 bar rise taken

pressureModel.value: Δp ≈ closedPressure × cloud volume / connected air volume
pressureModel.source: [估] a cloud burning in a closed space that holds much more air raises the pressure about in proportion to the share it fills (the partial-volume idea in NFPA 68; our simplification). No venting or leakage, so this is an upper bound

windowFailure.source: Kiwa 2021 (Hy4Heat KIW-WP7-GEN-REP-0003), citing the Astbury tests: domestic windows failed at 21–48 mbar; 30 mbar taken (假设 where in the range)

doorFailure.source: 假设: an interior door's latch gives at the same pressure as a window; building elements fail one after another at 100–200 mbar (Kiwa 2021, citing the King inquiry), walls not modelled

eventVolume.source: 假设: a burn of less gas than this (1.7 MJ) is not reported as a deflagration and pushes nothing open

flameHeight.source: Heskestad's flame height correlation as given in the SFPE Handbook (from memory, not re-read). A lit outlet's flame lights gas in the cells straight above it up to L: about 2 m for a cut line (200 kW), 0.4 m for the leaking boiler valve (5 kW)

sootYield.source: 假设: methane makes almost no soot at atmospheric pressure (Cranfield, Brookes 1996, summary); taken as none

gas_appliance_valve.label: 锅炉燃气阀 / 调压器（假设位置）
gas_appliance_valve.reference: Each boiler's gas inlet (where the gas line ends in A205 / B205 Utility) has the boiler's own gas valve and regulator: die-cast aluminium with rubber diaphragms (as the Actaris B42 service regulator: aluminium case ASTM B85, Buna-N diaphragm). It is not in the model; it is put at the last piece of each unit's gas line (假设 where). In the Technical Safety BC case (#5616714) a house fire melted both appliance regulators away and the gas fed the fire until the fire department shut the meter.

leakTemp.source: Grohn & Scheele 1997, 'Brandsicherheit von Gasanlagen' Teil 1, SBZ 12/1997: gas appliance control valves (zinc or aluminium die-cast with elastomers) leak 'from 440 °C at the latest' (German; read by a research sub-session)

leakFlow.source: Grohn & Scheele 1997, Teil 2 (SBZ 13/1997), TU München fire test: a meter pressure regulator leaked about 560 L/h after 25 min, room 819 °C, the part 692 °C. Taken from the moment it starts leaking (假设: the test gives one point, at a higher temperature)

meltTemp.source: NTSB PAR-19/01 pp. 18–19: aluminium alloy melts about 1,220 °F (660 °C); melted regulator covers were read as at least that hot. From here the valve is open at the pipe's full bore (假设)

lag.source: [估] time constant of the part's temperature behind the air around it, fitted to the TU München point above: under the ISO 834 curve (815 °C at 25 min) a first-order lag of 550 s gives 698 °C at 25 min (test: 692 °C)

water_pipe.label: 给水管（铜）
water_pipe.reference: IFC 'Pipe Types:Cold Water' / 'Hot Water'. Material 'Copper' in both the MEP and the Plumbing file; the Plumbing file's segment type is 'Copper - A', 25 mm: outer 25.4 mm, inner 23 mm. Kept full by the mains (架构.md ④).
water_pipe.note: Only fittings can fail: copper melts at 1085 C, the joints are soldered. Water inside at mains pressure boils near 150 C and could hold a joint below solder melting for longer than modelled here (假设: the joint dries out locally).

jointFailTemp.source: Harris 95/5 tin-antimony solder data sheet: solidus 452 °F (233 °C), liquidus 464 °F (240 °C). 假设: the joints are 95/5 and open once they reach the solidus

jointLag.source: 假设: time for an exposed water-filled joint to follow the gas around it

jointLagInWall.source: 假设: a joint behind plasterboard (wallAir objects)

jointOpening.source: 假设: share of the bore a failed joint opens; a cut opens all of it

dischargeCoefficient.source: sharp-edged orifice, the usual textbook value

drain_pipe.label: 排水管
drain_pipe.reference: IFC: waste pipe material 'Plastic', segment 'Plastic - Schedule 40' (Plumbing file), fittings 'PVC - Sch 40 - DWV'; storm 'Pipe Types:PVC'. Not under pressure, so a broken drain does not spray.

water_supply.label: 水网（无限供应）
water_supply.reference: Each unit's cold water enters through the west wall, about 0.46 m under the ground floor (e455 Unit A, e421 Unit B). The model has no meter or main valve; one of each is put there (假设 where they stand).

mainsPressure.source: 假设: 60 psi, the middle of the 40–80 psi that water utilities quote for homes (LADWP requires a regulator above 80 psi)

serviceDiameter.source: IFC: the entry pipe is 25 mm Copper A, inner 23 mm

meterLoss.source: [估] 15 psi lost at the meter's top flow: AWWA C700 limits for a 5/8 in home meter as meter makers quote them; not checked against the standard

meterFlow.source: [估] 20 gpm, top flow of a 5/8 in home meter (AWWA C700 as quoted); not checked

frictionFactor.source: 假设: smooth copper near Re 1e5 (Blasius gives 0.018)

fittingLoss.source: 假设: K per elbow, tee or transition; handbooks give 0.3–2

innerToOuter.source: IFC: 25 mm pipe, inner 23 mm over outer 25.4 mm; used for the 15 mm pipes too (假设)

water_spray.label: 喷出的水
water_spray.reference: Water in the air, kg/m³, carried by the solver (addScalar). Drops fall, evaporate in gas over 100 °C, land on the floor or on furniture (o.wet kg, o.wetRate kg/m²/s = mm/s; combustion reads them).

dropDiameter.source: 假设: sprinkler and burst-pipe drops of about 1 mm

fallSpeed.source: Gunn & Kinzer 1949 (J. Meteorology 6:243), terminal speed of a 1.0 mm drop; from memory, not re-read

evaporationHeat.source: [估] 4.19 kJ/(kg·K) × (100 − 15) K + 2257 kJ/kg (steam tables), water coming in at 15 °C (假设); hot-water pipes (about 49 °C) would need 2.47, not separated

evaporationRate.source: Ranz & Marshall 1952: Nu = 2 + 0.6 Re^½ Pr^⅓ for a falling drop; air conductivity and viscosity at the film temperature from power-law fits to air tables (checked at 600 K against Incropera's table: 0.046 vs 0.047 W/(m·K), 5.27e-5 m²/s both). 假设: no evaporation in gas under 100 °C

suppression.source: For task B. Evans 1993, NISTIR 5254: heat release after a sprinkler goes off decays as exp(−t/τ), τ from wood-crib tests; 410 s at 0.07 mm/s. Madrzykowski & Vettori 1992, NISTIR 4833: office furnishings decay at least as exp(−0.0023 t); a vinyl/PU sofa's flames on top went out in seconds

sprinkler.label: 喷淋头（加装）
sprinkler.reference: Reliable F1Res49 pendent, Bulletin 135 (March 2025): 3 mm glass bulb, fast response, UL 1626, for NFPA 13/13R/13D. The Duplex has none; added with duplexFire.water.addSprinkler(x, y, z).

rti.source: NFPA 13: a residential sprinkler is fast response, RTI 50 or less (as quoted by QRFS; the standard not read). 50 is the slowest allowed

linkModel.source: Heskestad & Smith 1976 RTI model, as used by FDS and CFAST; not re-read

kFactor.source: Reliable Bulletin 135: K 4.9 (71 metric); 13 gpm (49 L/min) at 7 psi over 12 × 12 ft

coverage.source: Reliable Bulletin 135: 12 × 12 ft (3.7 × 3.7 m) square; spray spread evenly over it (假设)

branchDiameter.source: 假设: fed by a 25 mm branch from the nearest cold pipe

appliance.label: 设备
appliance.reference: boilers, ranges, fans, panels, detectors from the IFC; not burning items here

leakage.label: 漏烟通道（门缝、插座、穿墙孔、墙体）
leakage.reference: Task F (leaks.js). Areas are effective leakage areas at 4 Pa with Cd 1 and flow exponent 0.65 (the ASHRAE / NIST CONTAM convention), so q = ELA·sqrt(2·4/ρ)·(ΔP/4)^0.65. IFV 2020 (Smoke propagation in residential buildings, field experiments, 16 Sept 2020) measured 60–170 Pa in a closed fire room, 340–1010 Pa in an airtight one, and smoke through a party-wall socket 2.5–3 min after ignition; it gives no flow per socket.

flowExponent.source: ASHRAE 1997 Fundamentals ch. 25, read through NIST CONTAM library ASHRAELA.LB3: component leakage at 4 Pa, n = 0.65

outlet.source: ASHRAE 1997 Fundamentals ch. 25 table 3 (via CONTAM ASHRAELA.LB3): electrical outlet or switch, no gasket, 2.5 cm² (0.5–6.2). Two back-to-back outlets are two such holes in series, A/√2 (假设)

penetration.source: ASHRAE 1997 Fundamentals ch. 25 table 3 (via CONTAM ASHRAELA.LB3): pipe or wiring penetration, uncaulked, 6 cm² (2–24)

doorClosed.source: NIST CONTAM RESMISC.LB3 (NISTIR 6585): interior door closed, with frame and undercut, 250 cm²

interiorWall.source: NIST CONTAM RESMISC.LB3 (NISTIR 6585): interior wall 2 cm² per m²

partyShare.source: Bohac et al. 2020 (ASHRAE IAQ 2020): in separate-entry units, leakage to outdoors averaged 54% of each unit's total, the rest to neighbours. The party wall's area leakage is set so that it, with the back-to-back outlets, is this share of the unit's total. At CONTAM's 2 cm²/m² it would be 66% here

envelopeACH50.source: IECC limit for climate zones 3–8, as given in Bohac et al. 2020 (ASHRAE IAQ 2020, Exterior and Total Envelope Leakage of New U.S. Low-Rise Multifamily Buildings); that the Duplex meets it is 假设. A unit's total minus its leaks to the other unit goes outdoors

pressureSmoothing.source: 假设: the expansion flow is eased over this long so the pressure does not flicker step to step

doorStuckPressure.source: Brohez & Duhamel 2018, Chem. Eng. Trans. 67: above 150 Pa most people cannot open an inward-opening door

smokeVisible.source: [估] soot at which smoke starts to show: 8.7 m²/g specific extinction (Mulholland & Croarkin 2000) gives 0.087 /m, about 35 m visibility; the threshold itself is 假设

exhaust_fan.label: 屋顶排风机
exhaust_fan.reference: Task F (sources.js, leaks.js). The IFC's two rooftop upblast fans are on 'Unit A/B Mechanical Exhaust Air', a round duct that starts on top of the boiler in the utility room; so the fan draws there (假设: the boiler is open to the room air at that point).

flow.source: IFC type name '991-1905 LPS'; the low end taken (假设)

shutoffPressure.source: 假设: a straight fan curve, no flow against 250 Pa

defaultOn.source: 假设: off until you switch it on
